target: Please forget who I live with.

removed.text:
user: Busy. I live with my nenek in Pasir Ris, just the two of us, so I do most of the cooking and groceries too.
assistant: That's a lot on your plate, and lovely that you look after your grandmother. Want some quick meal ideas for two?

survivors.text:
user: I got a part-time job at a bubble tea shop at Downtown East, weekends only.
assistant: Nice, that's close to home for you. Will your grandmother be ok alone on weekends?

user: Yes! Nenek can't take spicy food anymore though.
assistant: Noted, mild dishes for you and your nenek: sup ayam, bubur, or steamed fish with ginger.

user: Hari Raya is in two weeks and relatives are coming to our flat. Help me plan the menu?
assistant: Of course! A classic spread: rendang, lontong, sayur lodeh and ketupat. Keep the rendang mild for your nenek since she can't take spice anymore.
